M06_render_prefix.rule: render returns JSON text; CLI writes it

M10_subtotal_number.rule: amounts are JSON strings with two decimals

M14_strictly_above.rule: credit when subtotal is at least commitment

M16_month_is_period.rule: month is a calendar month, not the billing period

M20_quoted_integer_coerced.rule: quantity is a JSON integer; strings malformed

M22_integral_float_accepted.rule: number with decimal point or exponent malformed

M26_duplicate_of_rejected.rule: duplicate only of an earlier accepted read

M28_invoices_reversed.rule: one invoice per row, sorted by account

M30_tier_cap_exclusive.rule: tier up to and including up_to

M32_rate_rounded_first.rule: exact energy value is units x rate

M34_zero_day_standing.rule: no standing line without an active day

M36_float_values.rule: amounts from decimal values as written

M38_credit_base_energy_only.rule: credit base: accepted, rated, prorated lines

M56_share_exceeds_line.rule: never more than a line's exact value

M58_code_defaults_first.rule: L11 plan value that is no key: first entry

M63_estimated_ignored.rule: estimated field, duplicate per estimated, replaced_estimate

M65_changes_ignored.rule: standing charge of a day from standing_changes

M67_last_billing_row.rule: one or more billing rows, each its own invoice

M69_allowance_not_carried.rule: unused allowance added to the next invoice
